reproduction.schedule: budget_spent_by_last_read: the raw read that completes a source's delivery also charges the whole 15s request budget (COLLECTOR_REQUEST_READ_BUDGET_SECONDS) on the virtual clock. Fails every time on the pre-change assertion (assert 1 == 60 at the sleep hook once both latest_priority.json say done).
reproduction.observed_values: tick 35: twse delivered its last 33 rows, latest_priority.json done=true for both sources, tick result continuation_pending=true -> sleep 1; tick 36: tpex pulled with 0 rows, continuation_pending=true (twse still owed its ordered-sweep tick) -> sleep 1; then 60.
reproduction.what_varies: the virtual clock. LatencyTransport charged max(start+0.27) over real thread overlap, so a batch cost 0.27s..1.08s depending on whether reader threads happened to overlap; on a loaded runner the pull that lands the last row may or may not have spent the 15s budget. Verified: the sequential schedule alone (no overlap) never trips this assertion but charges 3212s of virtual time, so overlap does change batch boundaries.

decision.wrong_side: the test model, not the product
decision.proof: connectors/collector_bundle.py _pull_bounded (~lines 845-885): the ordered sweep runs only if done and the shared deadline has not passed (`not (op_deadline is not None and time.monotonic() >= op_deadline)`); otherwise base=None with complete=False and the result carries continuation_pending=True when `merged and (not done or not base.complete)`. controller_worker.main (~line 2476) then sleeps CONTINUATION_PAUSE_SECONDS. The extra short tick is intended: the ordered history sweep was not evaluated, so 'nothing left' cannot be claimed; the follow-up pull delivers 0 rows and restores the cadence.
decision.replacement_assertion: the old `seconds == interval` on the first all-done tick is replaced by: at most one extra continuation tick per source after all rows are acknowledged, every receipt after that has normalized_count 0, the last tick sleeps interval_seconds, and under the forced boundary schedule exactly len(sources) extra ticks occur.
